title: Ashura 10th Muharram - Duas.org
text: Ashura 10th Muharram - Duas.org       Ashura 10th Muharram "O' Fatimah! Every eye shall be weeping on the Day of Judgment except the eye which has shed tears over the tragedy of Husain (as).. Holy Prophet (saw) Know More Importance × Click Here for know more On this day, Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was martyred. It is indeed the day of the calamitous misfortune and the day of grief for the Holy Imams (peace be upon them) and their Shi'as (adherents). Thus, the Shi`ah are required to stop pursuing any worldly benefit,and devote themselves to weeping and mourning the misfortunes of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him). They are thus required to hold consolation ceremonies in the same way as they do for their own deceased. The adherents (Shi`ah) of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him) should commemorate the martyrdom of their Imam and should weep for him as narrated in innumerable hadith from Masumeen(as). This is one of the best ways to give the " Ajr Risalat" for the Prophet(saws) Qurba as commanded by Quran in 42:23 × .
